annotations.title: Turn an app feature on or off

description: Turns one extension or AI feature (id from cometchat_list_features) on or off for a live app. AI features need an OpenAI key first (cometchat_set_openai_key). For extensions, confirmed: false means check the dashboard's Extensions page.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has explicitly agreed to this change. Without it, nothing happens and you get a summary to show them.

enabled.description: true to turn on, false to turn off

feature_id.description: Extension or AI feature id from cometchat_list_features

name: cometchat_set_feature

confirmed.description: Whether reading the app back shows the new state. false = CometChat accepted the change but it isn't visible yet; tell the user to check the dashboard.

kind.description: What kind of feature it is

title: Turn an app feature on or off
